description: CREATES a new check — this MODIFIES live monitoring config. Provide a `timeout` (simple period-based check) OR a `schedule` + `tz` (cron-based check); the two are mutually exclusive. Use `unique` to avoid creating duplicates. Assign notifications via `channels`. Healthchecks: POST /checks/. Returns the created check (201) or the existing match (200).

channels.description: Integrations to assign: "*" for all, or a comma-separated list of integration ids.

grace.description: Grace time in seconds after the deadline before the check goes down.

manual_resume.description: If true, a paused check does not auto-resume on the next ping (resume manually).

schedule.description: Cron expression for the expected ping schedule (e.g. "15 5 * * *"). Mutually exclusive with `timeout`; requires `tz`.

slug.description: URL slug (used for slug-based ping URLs).

tags.description: Space-separated list of tags, e.g. "prod db backups".

timeout.description: Expected period between pings, in seconds (60..31536000). Mutually exclusive with `schedule`.

tz.description: Server's timezone for the cron `schedule`, e.g. "Europe/Riga".

unique.description: Dedupe fields — if a check already matches on these (e.g. ["name"]), it is returned instead of created.

name: healthchecksio_create_check
title: Create check

description: PERMANENTLY DELETES a check by UUID — this MODIFIES live monitoring config and cannot be undone. Healthchecks: DELETE /checks/{uuid}. Returns the deleted check's last known state.
name: healthchecksio_delete_check
title: Delete check

description: Get a single check using uuid or unique_key returned by healthchecksio_list_checks with this project's API key. Do not pass a check name, slug or ping URL. Returns status, timeout/schedule, grace, tags and last ping; read-only keys omit sensitive fields. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}.

uuid.description: The exact uuid or unique_key returned by healthchecksio_list_checks for this project; not a name, slug or ping URL.

name: healthchecksio_get_check
title: Get check

description: Get the logged request body of a single ping, returned as PLAIN TEXT (verbatim, not JSON). Requires a read-write project API key and the check's uuid from healthchecksio_list_checks; a read-only unique_key is not supported. Get n from healthchecksio_list_pings; not every ping has a saved body. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}/pings/{n}/body.

n.description: The ping's sequence number (the `n` field from list_pings).

uuid.description: The check's uuid returned by healthchecksio_list_checks with a read-write project key; not unique_key, a slug or a ping URL.

name: healthchecksio_get_ping_body
title: Get ping body

description: List the project's status-badge URLs per tag (plus "*" for the overall status) — {badges:{...}}. Healthchecks: GET /badges/.
name: healthchecksio_list_badges
title: List badges

description: List all checks in the API key's project, optionally filtered by slug and/or tags. Returns {checks:[...]} with status, schedule and last ping. A read-write key also returns uuid and ping_url; a read-only key returns unique_key instead. Pass a returned uuid or unique_key to get_check/list_flips. Ping history and writes need a read-write key and uuid. Healthchecks: GET /checks/.

slug.description: Filter to checks with this exact slug.

tag.description: Filter to checks carrying ALL of these tags (each is sent as a separate `tag` query param).

name: healthchecksio_list_checks
title: List checks

description: List a check's status changes ("flips") over time — [{timestamp, up}]. Works with a read-only or read-write project key: use the unique_key or uuid returned by healthchecksio_list_checks for that project. Optionally scope by a lookback window or an explicit start/end range. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}/flips/.

end.description: Return only flips at/before this Unix timestamp.

seconds.description: Return only flips from the last N seconds.

start.description: Return only flips at/after this Unix timestamp.

uuid.description: The exact uuid or unique_key returned by healthchecksio_list_checks for this project; not a name, slug or ping URL.

name: healthchecksio_list_flips
title: List flips

description: List the project's notification integrations ("channels") — {channels:[{id, name, kind}]}. The ids are what you assign to a check's `channels` field. Needs a read-write API key: a read-only key gets HTTP 401. Healthchecks: GET /channels/.
name: healthchecksio_list_integrations
title: List integrations

description: List a check's logged pings (100 on the free plan, 1000 on paid), most recent first. Requires a read-write project API key and the uuid returned by healthchecksio_list_checks. A read-only key and its unique_key cannot read ping history; use list_flips for status changes or reconnect with a read-write key. Each ping: type, date, n, scheme, remote_addr, method, ua, rid, duration, body_url. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}/pings/.

uuid.description: The check's uuid returned by healthchecksio_list_checks with a read-write project key; not unique_key, a slug or a ping URL.

name: healthchecksio_list_pings
title: List pings

description: PAUSES a check — disables monitoring without deleting it (it stops going down for missed pings until it next receives a ping or is resumed). This MODIFIES live monitoring config. Healthchecks: POST /checks/{uuid}/pause (empty body).
name: healthchecksio_pause_check
title: Pause check

description: RESUMES a paused check — re-enables monitoring. This MODIFIES live monitoring config. Returns HTTP 409 (surfaced cleanly) if the check is not currently paused. Healthchecks: POST /checks/{uuid}/resume (empty body).
name: healthchecksio_resume_check
title: Resume check

description: UPDATES an existing check by UUID — this MODIFIES live monitoring config. Send only the fields you want to change (timeout and schedule remain mutually exclusive). Healthchecks: POST /checks/{uuid}. Returns the updated check.
